subject: planner: add `model.ExtraPhysTblID` into indexScan.Schema() (#44985)
summary: Diff adds `model.ExtraPhysTblID` into `PhysicalIndexScan.initSchema()` when it exists in `is.Columns`, aligning IndexScan schema with the extra output column requested for partition-table ordering/locking paths. Executor-side `needPartitionHandle` logic in `executor/distsql.go` and `executor/index_merge_reader.go` is relaxed to only reject the dangerous case (partition-handle needed but extra column missing), while allowing `ExtraPhysTblID` to be present solely for `SelectLock` without triggering internal errors. Added/adjusted tests exercise `SELECT ... FOR UPDATE` on partitioned tables (including ORDER BY + LIMIT). No remaining Blocker/High issues found in the touched planner/executor behavior.
